title: Helldiver Dress - Pissenlit
description:
Helldiver has our classic fit and flare cut with a square neck and a mid-length lantern sleeve. There are pockets in the skirt and it closes with a back invisible zipper.

This spectacular, large-scale cotton print features beautifully illustrated ochre dandelions with olive coloured leaves, on a sage green background.

Shoulder to hem measures 40". The exterior fabric is 100% cotton, and the soft satin that lines the skirt is 96% polyester, 4% spandex. This dress can be washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry.

Hilary is 5'7 and wears our size 12. See our size chart here.

This style is also available in Blue Veronica, Grazing and Eternal Midnight! Made in Canada.

title: Foglark Dress - Byzantine Garden
description:
Foglark is a tailored sheath dress with a mid-length lantern sleeve and a square neck. There are flat pockets on the skirt and it closes with a back invisible zipper.

This richly coloured Japanese cotton print features decorative flowers in blue and rosewood pink with metallic gold accents.

Shoulder to hem measures 34". The exterior fabric is 100% cotton, and the soft satin that lines the skirt is 96% polyester, 4% spandex. This dress can be washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry.

Aishah is 5'7 and wears our size 6. See our size chart here.

This style is also available in Tussie Mussie, Cotton Puff and Night Rain! Made in Canada.

title: Winter Chippy Dress - Bellflower
description:
Winter Chippy was developed from one of our longest-running cuts, Gallinule, but has a slightly wider neck, a longer hemline, and a lovely elbow length sleeve! It has our classic fit and flare cut, with pleats at the waist, and front skirt pockets. 

Nirmala is 5'2" and wears our size 10. Winter Chippy measures 39"(2) to 42"(18) from shoulder to hem - you can see our size chart here.

The print is an OEKO-Tex certified 100% cotton, which means that every component has been tested for harmful substances and found to not be ecologically harmful. The skirt is lined in soft satin that is 96% polyester and 4% spandex, and the dress closes with a back invisible zipper. Winter Chippy can be hand or machine washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry.

This style is also available in Keepsake and Bellflower! 

Everything at Birds of North America is vegan and has been made ethically in Canada since we began in 2007. We have a strong focus on sustainability, and strive to create high-quality garments that last a long time. You can browse vintage Birds styles that we've gathered back as part of our buyback program in our ReNesting section!

title: Tystie Jacket - Garage Blue
description:
Tystie is a jacket with white contrast topstitching, patch pockets and a front button closure. It is made of a thick, but soft, 100% cotton Japanese twill.

This jacket has an oversize fit and looks fabulous worn both a bit larger or a bit smaller, depending on your preference! If you'd like it to fit the way it does on our models, we recommend these size equivalents:

Birds 2-6, or XS-S, we recommend the XS
Birds 6-10, or S-M, we recommend the S
Birds 10-14, or M-L, we recommend the M
Birds 14-18, or XL-XXL, we recommend the L

You can see our size chart here for reference! Liz is 5'9" and wears our size S, and Hilary is 5'7" and wears our size M in the photos. You can make a matching set with Bonxie pants in Garage Blue, shown here. Tystie measures about 28" from shoulder to hem, and is also available in Black and Nightfall Rose. This jacket can be hand or machine washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry. 

Everything at Birds of North America is vegan and has been made ethically in Canada since we began in 2007. title: Beetlehead Tee - Berries
description:
Our popular baby tee, Beetlehead, is back in new prints! We’ve also added size 3X for the first time this season!

This cute tee is made of deadstock cotton jersey that is 95% cotton, 5% spandex. Shoulder to hem, it measures 17”(XS)-22”(3X). This style is also available in Bluey Ringwald, Phlox and Happy Daisy.

Beetlehead can be hand or machine washed on a cold, delicate cycle and laid flat to dry, or tossed in the dryer if you don’t mind it shrinking a little bit! Shown here with our Bloodfool pant in Denim.

Hayley is 5'7" and wears our size XS. See our size chart here.

title: Dabchick Short - Teal
description:
Dabchick is a pleated short with front pockets, belt loops, and a classic fly front. It's made of a beautiful, pre-washed 100% linen, and closes with a button at the waist.

This fabric is OEKO-TEX certified, and will get softer and more beautiful every time you wash it for years to come!  OEKO-TEX certification means that every component of the material has been tested and found to be free of harmful substances. The Dabchick is also made in Canada!

The inseam measures 4.5", and you can hand or machine wash this short on a delicate cycle in cold water and hang it to dry. Dabchick is also available in Black and Lilac, and can make a matching set with our Jiddy Hawk top!  

Marie is 5'1" and wears our size 18. You can see our size chart here.

title: Grosbeak Dress - Sour Cherry
description:
Grosbeak has Birds’ flattering fitted bodice and pleated skirt, as well as deep front pockets, a button placket detail, and a sweetheart shaped neckline. This gorgeous cotton print, Sour Cherry, is chock full of tart looking summer cherries! 

The dress and lining are both 100% cotton, and the dress closes with an invisible zipper down the back. Grosbeak measures about 40" from shoulder to hem. Mila is 5'5" and wears our size 14. You can see our size chart here.

You can hand or machine wash this dress on a cold, delicate cycle, and hang it to dry. This style is also available in Blue Meadow and Suburban Night Hedge. Made in Canada.

title: Vesper Sparrow Dress - Royal Stripe
description:
Vesper Sparrow is the epitome of breezy summer style with its playful stripes and easy fit. It's made of a gorgeous 100% linen and is fully lined in breathable cotton voile. It has front patch pockets and the front closes with a long row of white buttons. 

Shoulder to hem measures about 43". You can hand or machine wash the dress on a delicate cycle in cold water and hang it to dry.

This dress is also available in Lavender Stripe, and is made in Canada! Sahara is 5'9" and wears our size 2. You can see our side chart here.

title: Dickcissel Jumpsuit - Teal Buttercups
description:
This new printed jumpsuit has a cropped, wide leg, and full sleeve, and a scoop neck. There are pockets in the pants, and it closes with a back invisible zipper.

This style is also available in Jungle Cat, Shadow Plum, and Sapphire.

Inseam is 25".

Content: 100% Cotton

Hand wash cold, hang to dry.

See our size chart here. Please note that these jumpsuits fit a size small, so please go with a size larger than what our size chart indicates for you!

Made in Canada.

title: Yellowhammer Dress - Forager
description:
Yellowhammer is a lovely fall dress with long full sleeves, a mid-knee length skirt with pockets, and a flattering V-neck. It closes with a back invisible zipper and the skirt is lined in soft satin.

This print has an indigo base with lime and forest green depictions of forest plants. There is a lady walking among the greenery, along with a sneaky fox and a bunny (!), foraging for forest treasures to take home!

This style is also available in Solarized and Redwood Meadow.

Shoulder to hem measures 39". The exterior fabric is 100% cotton, and the soft satin that lines the skirt is 96% polyester, 4% spandex. Hand wash cold, hang to dry. Made in Canada. 

See our size chart here.

title: Flowerpiercer Dress - Black
description:
Flowerpiercer is a relaxed fit dress made of thick, textured 100% cotton.. It has in-seam skirt pockets and full sleeves that gather into a cuff. It pops on over the head, and closes with a button and loop at the back neck. Flowerpiercer is also available in Rust, Indigo and Burgundy!

Flowerpiercer can be hand or machine washed on a cold, delicate cycle and hung to dry. This dress has a very relaxed silhouette, so if you would like a fit similar to what you see on the models, you can follow our size chart recommendations for your body measurements here.

title: Gift Card
description:
Treat someone you love to a Birds of North America gift card!

When you purchase a gift card online, you will be sent an order confirmation e-mail with your order number, followed within 24 hours by an e-mail with a unique gift code.

You can copy and send the gift code to the recipient, print the page out, or take a screen shot of it to send them. When the recipient is ready to redeem their gift card, there is a place to enter the gift code during the checkout process on our website.

Please choose the free 'studio pickup' option for 'shipping' on your gift card purchase. 

If you are giving the card as a gift, we recommend entering only your own information during the purchase process, and then later forwarding the gift code information to the recipient. That way they won't receive a premature notification of the gift card purchase, and you'll retain a copy of both your order confirmation and the gift code!

Please don't hesitate to e-mail us at service@birdsofnorthamerica.com if you have any questions, need assistance, or would like to purchase a gift code in a different denomination than we have listed!

Please note that discount codes can not be used to purchase gift cards.

description:
Birds x Neil MacCormick

These tees are a collaboration between Birds of North America and artist Neil MacCormick. Neil has painted full time since 1984 and co-owns Birds of North America with his partner, designer Hayley Gibson. The two have shared a studio since meeting in 2006.

Wally’s Burgers

I have no personal memory or experience of this sign, but it stood out so clearly to me when I was going through Neil’s work. I think one of the reasons I love this image (aside from the very cool sign, and the fact that everyone loves burgers, amiright? 😆) is the clear blue brightness of it. Neil paints using only 6 colours, and no white, so any luminosity in the image is just the unpainted white surface of the illustration board showing through. It makes for a unique feeling of gentle brightness in his work - like the image is illuminated from within. 

Neil randomly stumbled upon this burger joint on the Kingsway in Vancouver on one of the super long (20k+!) walks he would take around the city after taking the ferry over from Vancouver Island for the day. It’s such a beautiful example of one of the old neon signs that were still to be found in Vancouver from the 60’s when it first opened. Neil painted ‘Wally’s Burgers’ in 2000.

title: 'Beware of Dog' Tee
description:
Birds x Neil MacCormick

These tees are a collaboration between Birds of North America and artist Neil MacCormick. Neil has painted full time since 1984 and co-owns Birds of North America with his partner, designer Hayley Gibson. The two have shared a studio since meeting in 2006.

Beware of Dog

I love this painting so much. It’s not simply the pure, sunbaked feeling of summeriness that it captures, but also that this image celebrates what was a very commonly seen type of vehicle in the era in which I grew up in Victoria. My family didn’t have a camper, so they were never really demystified to me, and have remained quietly delightful objects. The idea that you could have a complete home with a bed and a kitchen and a bathroom and a little window like a house, all in a moving vehicle that you could drive somewhere else, still strikes me as a marvellous notion! 

Neil painted ‘Beware of Dog’ in 1993 from a photo he took in the Jubilee area of Victoria. BC. He noticed that people seemed to do more camping and roaming in Victoria, as opposed to going to cottages as people seemed to lean more towards in Toronto. This simple camper, sitting in a driveway, evokes a quiet, summery neighourhood feeling so strongly to me.

---

title: 'T & P Grocery' Tee
description:
Birds x Neil MacCormick

These tees are a collaboration between Birds of North America and artist Neil MacCormick. Neil has painted full time since 1984 and co-owns Birds of North America with his partner, designer Hayley Gibson. The two have shared a studio since meeting in 2006.

T & P Grocery

Just the shady side of a quiet corner store in the summer, but this image brings me right back to being a kid. Freezies, backyard hoses, dirty bare feet and the earthy softness of lying on sun-warmed grass while the smell of fried onions from a neighbourhood window is carried by on the summer breeze.  

Corner stores were all different, but always the same to me. The smell of the refrigerators, the frosty ice cream case and plastic pails of penny candy. I remember going in to stores like this with exactly one loonie, and taking my time to calculate how to get the most sugar for my buck, while also taking the 7 cents of tax into account. Very serious calculations! 😆 I didn’t know this corner store personally, but I know it intimately all the same. 

The original reference photo for this piece was taken by Neil in the Fernwood area of Victoria, and he painted ‘T & P Grocery’ in 2002.

---

title: 'Sparkle Bright Launderette' Tee
description:
Birds x Neil MacCormick

These tees are a collaboration between Birds of North America and artist Neil MacCormick. Neil has painted full time since 1984 and co-owns Birds of North America with his partner, designer Hayley Gibson. The two have shared a studio since meeting in 2006.

Sparkle Bright Launderette

This one is particularly special to me because I remember it so well from my childhood in Victoria! The name of the business, plus the darling little girl in the yellow dress and red socks, hits me right in the heart. 

Sparkle Bright was located in a little commercial strip on semi-busy Quadra street in Victoria, and there was a Dutch store right beside it that had traditional painted yellow wooden shoes in the window that I became obsessed with. I was 8 years old, and the shoes were $18, and it’s the first purchase I remember ever making (aside from candy!) with my own money! 

I’m not sure why those shoes beckoned to me so urgently, as I have no Dutch heritage, but I remember finding them beautiful and fascinating, and I ended up wearing them a lot! Maybe the little girl’s outfit inspired me, and I thought those shoes would help me to sparkle as brightly as she did ❤️

Neil painted Sparkle Bright Launderette in 1994, when he lived in Victoria. He had moved out west in 1989, after growing up in Toronto, and found that certain types of things stood out to him. ‘Victoria had a really different feeling to me - in a way I was just trying to identify what exactly that feeling was. Part of it was that the culture was so different, like the trailers and campers that dotted the streets. Part of it was the time capsule feeling of things that had disappeared in Toronto before I left - old storefronts and signs especially. It was like everything I was interested in was still there - as if the era I grew up in was still represented in Victoria.’   

---

title: Potoo Jacket - Dark Wash
description:

title: Wood Snipe Dress - The Pears of Wrath
description:

Wood Snipe closes with a back invisible zipper and is made of 100% cotton with a soft satin lining in the skirt that is 96% polyester and 4% spandex.

Casiornis is a lovely A-line dress with patch pockets. It has generous, elbow length sleeves that gather into a cuff, and a button-front closure.

Casiornis is fully lined in soft satin, and can be hand or machine washed on a cold, delicate cycle and hung to dry. The exterior is made of 100% cotton, and the lining is 96% polyester and 4% spandex.

It is available in three gorgeous cotton prints including Triffids, The Pears of Wrath, and this beauty, Nightfall! 

Erika is 5' and wears our size XS, and Hayley is 5'7" and wears our S. Casiornis fits true to our size chart, which you can see here. It is cut to graze the body with a bit of room, not to hug it, so it's normal for the dress measurements to be quite a bit larger than your body measurements. This dress doesn't have any stretch.

The length of the sleeve from the top of the shoulder to the sleeve hem ranges from 18" in the XS, to 19" in the 3X. Finished measurements of the dress bust/hip followed by shoulder-to-hem-length (in brackets), in inches, are as follows:

XS - 38/43  (35)
S - 40/45  (35.5)
M - 42/47  (36)
L - 44/49  (36.5)
XL - 46/51  (37)
2X - 49/54  (37.5)
3X - 52/57  (37.5)

title: Tailorbird Dress - Quatrefoil
description:
Tailorbird has an empire waist silhouette and square neck, with full sleeves that gather into an elasticised hem. It has pockets hidden in the side seams, closes with a back invisible zipper.

Tailorbird is fully lined in OEKO-TEX certified cotton voile, and can be hand or machine washed on a cold, delicate cycle and hung to dry. It is available in three gorgeous cotton prints, including Nightfall, Triffids, and Quatrefoil, a classic Gothic design element, featured here in black and white, with its signature four leafed clover shape.

Erika is 5' and wears our size S. Tailorbird fits true to our size chart. Though the bust measurements read as smaller than your body measurements may, you can follow our size chart for a tailored fit in this style, which you can find here. Honeycreeper is a perfectly simple summer shift dress, made of a stretch linen blend. It has a button front placket with mottled buttons, and pockets in the front skirt. It's also available in Black, Navy, Ochre and Smoky Rose.

This dress has quite a bit of stretch in the fabric. Shoulder to hem it measures 35”(XS)-39”(3X). The finished dress measurements in the Bust/Hip, in inches, are:

XS - 33/40
S - 35/42
M - 37/44
L - 39/46
XL - 42/49
2X - 45/52
3X - 48/56

You can see our size chart here. Liz is 5'9" and is wearing our size M. Honeycreeper can be hand or machine washed on a cold, delicate cycle and hung to dry. The fabric content is 55% linen, 43% rayon, 2% spandex.

Everything at Birds of North America is vegan and has been made ethically in Canada since we began in 2007. We have a strong focus on sustainability, and strive to create high-quality garments that last a long time. You can browse vintage Birds styles that we've gathered back as part of our buyback program in our ReNesting section!

title: Fairywren Dress - Farmhouse
description:
Fairywren is a joyful explosion of end-of-roll, deadstock cotton prints that have been rescued and assembled into two delightful wardrobe events - this one, Farmhouse, and Daisies!

This dress has a very relaxed fit, similar to our Devil Downhead cut, and we’ve just graded it into four sizes this season, XS-L, which cover our full XS-3X size range in terms of measurements.

These are the finished bust measurements of the dress:
XS - 38”
S - 40”
M - 44”
L - 49”

We recommend these size equivalents to your regular Birds size:

If you take size 2/4/6 - XS
If you take size 8/10 - S
If you take size 12/14 - M
If you take size 16/18/20 - L

This dress has a very relaxed fit, and can be worn larger or smaller and still look fantastic! Shoulder to hem, Fairywren measures 36.5”(XS)-38.5”(3X). It can be hand washed or machine washed on a cold, delicate cycle and hung to dry. Liz is 5'9" and wears our size S. You can see our size chart here.

title: Citril Finch Dress - Have a Nice Day!
description:

All of these prints are deadstock 100% cottons, and the dress can be hand or machine washed on a cold, delicate cycle and hung to dry. Shoulder to hem, Citril Finch measures 36.5”(XS)-39.5”(3X). The dress is also available in Navy Village Toile, Brick Village Toile and Red Patches.

This style has a very flexible fit, and works well worn both larger or smaller. The bust measurements for each size are below, as that's the only place it fits closely to the body. Finished bust measurements of the dress are as follows:

XS - 36”
S - 38”
M - 40”
L - 43”

title: Tern Pant - Red Currant
description:

The fabric is a comfortable stretch blend made of 50% cotton, 47% nylon and 3% spandex that breathes, and has excellent wrinkle resistance. Tern can be hand or machine washed on a cold, delicate cycle and hung to dry. 

We’ve added size 20 for this first time this season! The inseam measures 28” and the rise is 10.5”(2) - 12.5”(20). Hayley is 5'7" and wears our size 6. Shown here with Serin top in Black. See our size chart here.

Please note: Tern fits a whole size small this season, so please take a full size up from what your measurements indicate in our size chart!

title: Tern Pant - Deep Sea
description:
Tern is our longest running pant - a perfectly simple tapered-leg pant with a fantastic fit. It has front pockets and a back invisible zipper. There is an interior panel across the front to give extra support to the tummy area.

The fabric is a comfortable stretch blend made of 50% cotton, 47% nylon and 3% spandex that breathes, and has excellent wrinkle resistance. Tern can be hand or machine washed on a cold, delicate cycle and hung to dry. 

We’ve added size 20 for this first time this season! The inseam measures 28” and the rise is 10.5”(2) - 12.5”(20). Marie is 5'1" and wears our size 20. See our size chart here.

Please note: Tern fits a whole size small this season, so please take a full size up from what your measurements indicate in our size chart!

Finished measurements of the pants' waist/hip in inches are as follows:

2   - 27 / 37
4   - 28 / 38
6   - 29 / 39
8   - 30 / 40
10 - 32 / 42
12 - 34 / 44 
14 - 36 / 46
16 - 38 / 48
18 - 40 / 50
20 - 43 / 53

This pant has stretch, but not a TON of stretch. The 'waist' sits below the natural waist - an inch or so below the belly button, depending on different bodies.

This style is also available in Spruce, Pistachio, Peach, Red Currant, Navy and Black. It is shown here with Serin top in Sunflower.

Everything at Birds of North America is vegan and has been made ethically in Canada since we began in 2007. We have a strong focus on sustainability, and strive to create high-quality garments that last a long time. You can browse vintage Birds styles that we've gathered back as part of our buyback program in our ReNesting section!

title: Grass Owl Pant - Licorice Allsorts
description:
Party pants!!! Grass Owl is THE MOST FUN pair of pants you may ever own, with its two-tone candy-hued personality and wavy side seam groovy-ness.

The fabric has stretch, the inseam of Grass Owl measures 33” and the rise is 11.5”(2)-13”(20). Grass Owl is made of 97% cotton and 3% spandex. The pant can be hand or machine washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry.

Hayley is 5'7" and wears our size 4. You can see our size chart here. Shown here with Treehunter top in Lime. This fabric has stretch and has a tendency to stretch out a bit, so we recommend that you go for the smaller size if you're between sizes. The pants should fit snugly when you put them on in order for them to be perfect once you wear them for a bit!

This style is also available in Starburst, Sour Apple and SweeTart.

title: Nonpareil Jumpsuit - Royal
description:
Pockets abound in this ultra-practical stretch-twill boiler suit! There are patch pockets on both the bust and the seat, as well as angled pockets on the front leg - that’s SIX POCKETS!!!

Nonpareil hugs the bod in all the right places with its gently elasticated waist and stretchy cotton twill fabric. It closes with a zipper down the front and can be washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry. 

Nonpareil measures 55”(XS)-57”(3X) shoulder to hem. This jumpsuit is made of 97% cotton, 3% spandex stretch twill that has a soft hand, like peach skin. Marie is 5'1" and wears our size 2X. See our size chart here.

This style has a very relaxed fit, and works well worn a bit on the larger side. Finished bust and hip measurements of the jumpsuit are below. The elasticated waist stretches out to the approximate width of the bust:

XS - bust 37" - hip 40"
S   - bust 39" - hip 41"
M  - bust 41" - hip 43"
L   - bust 43" - hip 46"
XL - bust 45" - hip 48"
2X - bust 48" - hip 51"
3X - bust 51" - hip 53"

This style is also available in Iris, Avocado and Black!

title: Tiger Shrike Dress - Black
description:
Tiger Shrike is the perfect dress to bring a stunning pop of colour to the spring season! It slips on over the head and closes with a loop and a natural coconut shell button at the back.

There are pockets hidden in the side seams, and the dress measures 44”(XS)-46” (XL) from shoulder to hem. Tiger Shrike is made of 97% cotton, 3% spandex. It can be hand or machine washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry.
 
This dress has a relaxed fit, as well as stretch in the fabric, so we’ve just graded it into five sizes this season, XS-XL, which covers our full XS-3X size range in terms of measurements. You can see our size chart here for reference! Mila is 5'5" and wears our size M. This style is also available in Iris, Avocado and Denim!

*We recommend these size equivalents to your regular Birds size:
If you take size 2/4- XS
If you take size 6/8 - S
If you take size 10/12 - M
If you take size 14/16 - L
If you take size 18/20 - XL

Finished bust measurements of the dress are as follows:
XS - 34”
S - 37”
M - 40”
L - 45”
XL - 51”

title: Serin Blouse - Black
description:
Serin is a relaxed-fit blouse with a button-front placket and generous sleeves that gather into a cuff. The fabric is 100% OEKO-TEX certified cotton, and this blouse can be hand or machine washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry. OEKO-TEX certification means that every component has been tested for harmful substances and found to not be ecologically harmful.

Serin measures 21”(XS)-23”(2X) from shoulder to hem. Hayley is 5'7" and wears our size S. You can see our size chart here. This style is also available in Sunflower, Blood Orange, Cocoa and Sage! Shown here with Tern Pant in Red Currant.

description:
Marlinspike has an easy-to-wear empire waist silhouette and square neck. It’s the first time we’ve offered this Swamp-Angel-inspired silhouette in solid colours, and the beautiful selection of vibrant hues sets off the lines of this dress perfectly!

Marlinspike is fully lined in cotton voile, and both the exterior and lining are OEKO-TEX certified cottons. The dress measures 35”(XS)-37”(2X) from shoulder to hem, has pockets hidden in the side seams, and closes with a back invisible zipper. This dress can be hand or machine washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry.

Mila is 5'5" and wears our size L. You can see our size chart here.

This style is also available in Sunflower, Sage, Blood Orange and Cocoa!

Everything at Birds of North America is vegan and has been made ethically in Canada since we began in 2007. We have a strong focus on sustainability, and strive to create high-quality garments that last a long time. You can browse vintage Birds styles that we've gathered back as part of our buyback program in our ReNesting section!

title: Chestnut Bunting Dress - Flowerfall
description:

The 100% cotton print, ‘Flowerfall’, featuring beautifully illustrated teal, purple and pink blooms! It has our classic fit and flare cut, with pleats at the waist, and generous pockets in the skirt, and it closes with an invisible zipper in the back. 

The skirt is lined in soft satin that is 96% polyester and 4% spandex, and Chestnut Bunting can be hand or machine washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry.

title: Swamp Devil Dress - Everlasting
description:
Swamp Devil is a winter version of our popular cut, Swamp Angel! We’ve kept the same great empire waist silhouette with a pleated skirt, princess seams and a full short sleeve, and added a few inches for a perfect new winter length!

New print, ‘Everlasting’, has gorgeous ochre, green and rust floral sprays on a dark background! The print and the lining are both 100% cotton. Swamp Devil closes with a back invisible zipper and there are pockets hidden in the side seam!

Shoulder to hem measures 44"(XS)-47"(3X). This dress can be machine washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry. Hayley is 5'7" and wears our size S. See our size chart here. We suggest that you choose your size according to your bust measurement, as this dress fits most closely at the bust. Many of our Swamp Devil shoppers have found that they prefer the fit of this style on the larger side, so please don't hesitate to take the size on the larger end of your measurements! The suggested bust measurement size equivalents are as follows:

XS - 32-34" bust
S - 34-36" bust
M - 36-39" bust
L - 39-41" bust
XL - 41-44" bust
2X - 44-47" bust
3X -  47-50" bust
 

The dress is made in Canada, and is also available in Gravure and Flowerfall.

title: SS251 - 6 - Bloodfool Pant - Marmalade
description:
Special Notes: These pants are part of our studio sale, as they were cut with the velvety fabric facing a different direction in some pieces, causing a bit of a patchwork look! This pair has the left front pocket, right front pant leg, and the back right pocket facing in a different direction from the rest of the garment so it looks a bit lighter in some lights.

The velvety flares of your dreams!!! Bloodfool is a full length pant with patch pockets on the front and back, a fly front closure and button waist.

The fabric has a velvety, suede-like finish, and the stretch makes them fit like a HOT DAMN! The inseam measures 33” and the rise is 12”. The pant can be hand or machine washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry. The fabric content is 97% polyester and 3% spandex.

Candy is 6'1" and wears our size 10. See our size chart here.

Special note about fit: Most Bloodfool shoppers have found they prefer a full size smaller than their regular size in this pant. If you are between sizes, we suggest choosing the smaller size. If you aren't between sizes, we would still suggest sizing down if you seek a body-hugging fit like you see in the photo.

Made in Canada.

title: Swamp Angel Dress - Baby's Breath
description:
Swamp Angel is back!! This pleated babydoll dress was one of our most popular styles during its inaugural spring 2023 season, and we're so happy to welcome it back in new prints! With an empire waist, square neckline, generous sleeves, and pockets hidden in the side seams, this pretty birdie is fast on its way to becoming a Birds classic!

Nirmala is 5'2" and wears our size L, and Hayley is 5'7" and wears our size S. You can see our size chart here. We suggest that you choose your size according to your bust measurement, as this dress fits most closely at the bust. Many of our Swamp Angel shoppers have found that they prefer the fit of this style on the larger side, so please don't hesitate to take the size on the larger end of your measurements! The suggested bust measurement size equivalents are as follows:

XS - 32-34" bust
S - 34-36" bust
M - 36-39" bust
L - 39-41" bust
XL - 41-44" bust
2X - 44-47" bust
 
Swamp Angel measures 34"(XS) to 36.5"(XXL) from shoulder to hem and the print is an OEKO-Tex certified 100% cotton, which means that every component has been tested for harmful substances and found to not be ecologically harmful. It's fully lined in cotton voile and closes with a back invisible zipper. Swamp Angel can be hand or machine washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry.

This style is also available in Keepsake and Bellflower!

With an empire waist, square neckline, generous sleeves, and pockets hidden in the side seams, this pretty birdie is fast on its way to becoming a Birds classic!

Liz is 5'9" and wears our size S. You can see our size chart here. We suggest that you choose your size according to your bust measurement, as this dress fits most closely at the bust. Many of our Swamp Angel shoppers have found that they prefer the fit of this style on the larger side, so please don't hesitate to take the size on the larger end of your measurements! The suggested bust measurement size equivalents are as follows:

XS - 32-34" bust
S - 34-36" bust
M - 36-39" bust
L - 39-41" bust
XL - 41-44" bust
2X - 44-47" bust

Swamp Angel measures 34"(XS) to 36.5"(XXL) from shoulder to hem and the print is an OEKO-Tex certified 100% cotton, which means that every component has been tested for harmful substances and found to not be ecologically harmful. It's fully lined in cotton voile and closes with a back invisible zipper. Swamp Angel can be hand or machine washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry.

This style is also available in Baby's Breath and Keepsake! 
 

Everything at Birds of North America is vegan and has been made ethically in Canada since we began in 2007. We have a strong focus on sustainability, and strive to create high-quality garments that last a long time. You can browse vintage Birds styles that we've gathered back as part of our buyback program in our ReNesting section!

title: Swamp Angel Dress - Aster
description:
Swamp Angel is a pleated babydoll dress with an empire waist, princess seams, a full short sleeve, and pockets hidden in the side seam! The print and the lining are both 100% cotton, and the dress closes with a back invisible zipper.

Swamp Angel can be hand or machine washed on a cold delicate cycle and hung to dry. It measures 34.5” from shoulder to hem.

Candy is 6'1 and wears our size L. See our size chart here. We suggest that you choose your size according to your bust measurement, as this dress fits most closely at the bust. Many of our Swamp Angel shoppers have been finding that they prefer the fit of this style on the larger side, so don't hesitate to take the size on the larger end of your measurements! The suggested bust measurement size equivalents are as follows:

XS - 32-34" bust

S - 34-36" bust

M - 36-39" bust

L - 39-41" bust

XL - 41-44" bust

2X - 44-47" bust

This style is also available in Sunset and Larkspur! Made in Canada.
